NFL player – Emmitt Smith launched his NFL career in 1990 as the 17th overall draft pick, joining the Dallas Cowboys as a running back. Over the years, he became one of the team’s biggest stars, earning eight Pro Bowl selections and contributing to three Super Bowl victories. He later played two seasons with the Arizona Cardinals before announcing his retirement in February 2005. Off the field, Smith built a strong presence through endorsement deals with well-known companies such as Pepsi, Reebok, Bud Light, and QC Kinetix. He also expanded into new arenas, winning the third season of Dancing with the Stars in 2006 and later stepping into business leadership as President and CEO of Emmitt Smith Enterprises.
